overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: under G.L. c. 30A, § 20(f), the Chair had discretion to decide whether a person may address the board, so refusing the complainant's request during citizen's input was permitted. Resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: A complainant alleges the Board's Chair refused to let them address the Board during the citizen's input portion of an August 13 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Chair had discretion to decide whether to allow Mr. Murphy to address the Board during its August 13 meeting.
